files.billing/invoices.py:
import requests

API = "https://api.example.com/v2/invoices"


def fetch_all(session: requests.Session, since: str, max_pages: int = 500):
    """Every invoice created since `since`, following the API's cursor.

    Stops after `max_pages` pages so a misbehaving API can't loop forever.
    """
    out = []
    params = {"created_after": since, "limit": 200}
    cursor = None
    for _ in range(max_pages):
        if cursor:
            params["cursor"] = cursor
        resp = session.get(API, params=params, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        body = resp.json()
        out.extend(body["data"])
        next_cursor = body.get("next_cursor")
        if not next_cursor:
            break
    return out

defects.what: next_cursor is read but never assigned to cursor, so every page re-fetches the first page; 500 copies of page one are returned
